sentences.text:
And Others
Counsel for Applicant :- Pal Singh Yadav,Ashish Kumar Singh,Prathama Singh

Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Rajeev Singh,J.

1. Heard learned counsel for the applicant as well as learned Aga and perused the record.
2.

The present application has been filed by the applicant to direct learned Special Chief Judicial Magistrate (Custom), Lucknow to decide the Case No.58644 of 2022 arising out of Case Crime No.03/2021 under Section 498A, 354, 323, 506, 354(ga) I.P.C. and 3/4 of D.P. Act P.S. Gazipur,
District- Lucknow pending before him, expeditiously.
3. Learned counsel for the applicant submits that only prayer of the applicant is that a direction may be issued to decide the aforesaid case expeditiously.

4. Learned AGA has no objection to the innocuous prayer of the applicant Rehana Fatima vs State Of U.P. Thru. Addl. Chief Secy. ... on 9 November, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/100072942/

sentences.text:
In view of the above, without entering into merits of the case, I hereby direct learned Special Chief Judicial Magistrate (Custom), Lucknow to decide the Case No.58644 of 2022 arising out of Case Crime No.03/2021 under Section 498A, 354, 323, 506, 354(ga) I.P.C. and 3/4 of D.P. Act P.S.
Gazipur, District- Lucknow pending before him expeditiously in accordance with law preferably within a period of six months from the date a certified copy of this order is produced before him, if there is no legal impediment.

6. In view of the aforesaid terms, the application U/s 483 CrPC stands disposed of.
